messages:
Asha (PM): quick thread — Acme flagged two asks that hit Optimize toolkit: 1) fast quant profiles for Llama2-70B (they want ~2x cost reduction) and 2) adaptive prefix caching for our embed+generate flow. They want guidance on which to prioritize for their pilot.
Dmitri (Eng): curious — are they asking for full-product readiness or an early experiment?
Asha (PM): they want a pilot that reduces cost and keeps latency under 350ms p50. Pilot needs to be run in Dedicated.
Leah (ML): profiling note: quantization gives big token cost wins but risks slight quality drop on long-form completion. Prefix caching helps latency for repeated prompts but less unit-cost win on one-offs.
Tom (Product): can we do both with an MVP split? like quant-first (low infra lift) + simple LRU prefix cache as follow-up?
Maya (Solutions): Acme cares about predictable cost and auditability. They'd prefer a single rollout they can validate. Splitting might complicate their compliance review.
Dmitri (Eng): implementation rough estimates: quant pipeline + testing harness ~3 dev-weeks; validation + perf benchmarks + doc ~1.5w. LRU prefix cache (basic) ~2w infra + 1w testing. End-to-end integration and customer validation for either ~1w.
Asha (PM): throwing RICE numbers to compare. quick and dirty — scores 1-10 for Reach/Impact/Confidence, Effort in dev-weeks.
Asha (PM): ```
quant-profiles: Reach=7 Impact=8 Confidence=6 Effort=4  => RICE ~ (7*8*6)/4 = 84
prefix-cache: Reach=6 Impact=5 Confidence=7 Effort=3 => RICE ~ (6*5*7)/3 = 70
composite-rollout (both): Reach=8 Impact=9 Confidence=5 Effort=8 => RICE ~ (8*9*5)/8 = 45
```
Leah (ML): numbers seem reasonable. Important caveat: quant needs a canary for quality drift and eval harness; that adds operational gating.
Tom (Product): launch criteria proposal for pilot: 1) quant: <=5% mean ROUGE drop on our eval set, p50 latency <350ms, 20% cost reduction target. 2) cache: <5% hit false-positive rate, end-to-end p95 latency improvement >=15%.
Maya (Solutions): Acme will accept sequential releases if we provide a clear validation checklist and they can toggle features at route-level.
Dmitri (Eng): sequencing option A: quant-first (faster dev, higher RICE). Option B: cache-first (lower risk to quality, quicker customer-perceived latency). Both need rollout controls.
Asha (PM): decision leaning to quant-first based on RICE and Acme's cost priority, but we need to capture acceptance criteria + canary plan in the PRD.
Leah (ML): agree quant-first, but add a guardrail: if eval drift > threshold during canary, auto-fallback to FP16 and notify SRE. ops-bot can create the canary monitor.
ops-bot: Created monitor: optimize.quant.canary. Threshold: drift > 5% on eval metric => alert @eng-oncall.
Tom (Product): ok — next steps: Asha to update PRD with the above acceptance criteria + rollback plan, Dmitri to spike quant pipeline changes with test harness, Leah to prepare eval suite. Maya to prep customer toggle docs.
Asha (PM): thanks — I'll draft the PRD update and share a lightweight RACI. If no objections by EOD Friday we lock sequence as quant -> cache. :+1:
Dmitri (Eng): no objections from infra side.
Leah (ML): fine from ML.
Maya (Solutions): good with customer comms plan.
Tom (Product): noting dependencies: model-compile tooling needs minor update (Dmitri). Marking blocked until next sprint allocation.
Asha (PM): noted. I'll include dependency list. Closing thread for now — will post PRD link when ready.
